inventedEvidence.evidence: Thanks for confirming the vent hose is clear.

rationale: The assistant reached the right area (hose kinked and full of fluff) but repeated the same question and instructions, ignoring that the customer had already answered. The final message wrongly states the customer confirmed the hose is clear, when they said it was squashed and kinked and they were about to straighten it. It never advised clearing the fluff from the hose, replacing it if damaged, not leaving the dryer running unattended before the fix, or informing the landlord. It did avoid recommending any unnecessary part and gave a sensible monitoring instruction at the end.
